## Pacific Fishery Management Area Regulations, 2007 {#pacific-fishery-management-area-regulations-2007 .Title-of-Act}

[SOR]{.abbr title="Statutory Orders and Regulations"}/2007-77
:::

[FISHERIES ACT](/eng/acts/F-14)

Registration 2007-04-19

Pacific Fishery Management Area Regulations, 2007

P.C. 2007-557 2007-04-19
::::

:::::::::::::: section
::: {.section .order}
Her Excellency the Governor General in Council, on the recommendation of
the Minister of Fisheries and Oceans, pursuant to section 43[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#footnotea_e){#footnotea_e-ID0EFBAA} of the
[Fisheries Act](/eng/acts/F-14), hereby makes the annexed [Pacific
Fishery Management Area Regulations,
2007](/eng/regulations/SOR-2007-77).

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#footnotea_e-ID0EFBAA){#footnotea_e}S.C. 1991, c.
  1, s. 12
  :::
:::

## [Interpretation]{.HTitleText1} {#h-741581 .Part}

**[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in these Regulations.

[[Fishing Zone]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Fishing Zone]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in the
    [Oceans Act](/eng/acts/O-2.4). ([zone de pêche]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[management area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[management area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
    [[Area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a division of Canadian fisheries
    waters as enumerated and described in Schedule 2 and includes the
    portion of any stream that flows into that division and that is
    seaward of the mean high water mark near the mouth of that stream.
    ([secteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} or[ secteur
    d'exploitation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[mile]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[mile]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means nautical mile.
    ([mille]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[shoreline]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[shoreline]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the apparent high water
    mark. ([rivage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Subarea]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Subarea]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a subdivision of a management
    area. ([sous-secteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[surfline]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[surfline]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the lines described in
    Schedule 1. ([ligne de démarcation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

**[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** All geographical
co-ordinates referenced in the schedules are provided in the North
American Datum 83 (NAD 83) geodetic system.

**[[3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3 .sectionLabel}** All lines joining the
geographical co-ordinates of points described in the schedules are
interpreted as rhumb lines.

## [Application]{.HTitleText1} {#h-741591 .Part}

**[[4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations apply to
the Canadian fisheries waters of the Pacific Ocean.

## [Prescribed Areas]{.HTitleText1} {#h-741593 .Part}

**[[5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5 .sectionLabel}** The areas in the Canadian
fisheries waters of the Pacific Ocean described in Schedule 2 are hereby
prescribed as management areas.

## [Repeal]{.HTitleText1} {#h-741595 .Part}

**[[6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-6 .sectionLabel}** \[Repeal\]

## [Coming into Force]{.HTitleText1} {#h-741597 .Part}

**[[7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-7 .sectionLabel}** These Regulations come into
force on the day on which they are registered.
